§6Signalum-Plated Itemduct§f

§aMid-tier itemduct that fuses Impulse speed with Signalum capacity for busy trunk lines!§f

§bSignalum-Plated Itemducts§f are faster than Impulse and carry more per tick, ideal for main transport lines between processing areas. Craft them in a §bFluid Transposer§f with Signalum Ingot and Energized Glowstone.

Like all itemducts, items take the shortest path. Pair with §bFilters§f and §bServos§f for high-throughput routed networks. The Signalum plating also makes them visually distinct, so you can tell your trunk lines from feeder branches at a glance.

§eTip§f: Use §bSignalum-Plated§f on your main trunk lines and standard §bItemducts§f on short feeder branches. Cost vs throughput, only for the busiest segments.
